Classic HJ reachability considers finding the largest feasible set for deterministic environments. In this section, we apply a similar definition in [45, 46] and define the stochastic reachability problem.

It is insufficient to only consider instantaneous safety. When the environment and policy are both deterministic, we easily have a unique trajectory for starting from each state (i.e. the future state is uniquely determined) under Lipschitz environment dynamics.
